description: This Java class defines a custom Akka HTTP directive to ensure that request URIs are properly encoded. It provides a static method to wrap route logic with URI validation, logging any URI parsing errors and returning a 400 Bad Request if the URI is invalid.

classes.name: EncodingEnsuringDirective
classes.description: A utility class providing a static method to enforce URI encoding validation in Akka HTTP routes.

methods.name: ensureEncoding
methods.description: A static method that wraps a route with URI validation logic, checking for valid URI encoding and handling errors by returning a 400 Bad Request.
